categories.main_business_segments: Anhui Gujing Distillery Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the production and sales of baijiu (Chinese liquor), with its flagship product being Gujing Gongjiu. The company also operates in related sectors including hotel management and glass manufacturing through subsidiaries. Key product lines include the 'Year Original Pulp' series, Gujing Gongjiu series, and Huanghelou brand. The company maintains a dealer-based sales model with both online and offline channels.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced solid-state fermentation techniques and intelligent brewing technologies, including smart qu-making and fermentation process control. It integrates digital and AI-driven manufacturing processes, such as a 5G-enabled transparent factory and intelligent distillation models. Research collaborations with academic and industry experts support continuous innovation in flavor profiling, raw material utilization, and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are distributors and end consumers of premium baijiu products across China, with a focus on the mid-to-high-end market segment. The company serves regional markets with strong presence in Central China, North China, and South China, and has a small but growing international export business. The customer base includes retail, hospitality, and cultural sectors that value traditional and premium liquor products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant sales concentrated in Central China (85.46% of revenue), North China, and South China. It also has minor international sales and export activities. Production and administrative headquarters are located in Bozhou, Anhui Province, with subsidiaries and production bases in Anhui and Hubei provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anhui Gujing Distillery operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the baijiu supply chain, focusing on production, quality control, branding, and distribution. It controls raw material procurement, fermentation, distillation, packaging, and sales through a dealer network. The company also engages in upstream activities such as strategic raw material base planting to ensure quality and supply stability.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in intelligent brewing technologies, digital transformation, and product quality enhancement. R&D focuses include smart qu-making, fermentation microbiome research, flavor compound formation, and process automation. Strategic priorities include brand building, marketing innovation, talent development, and expanding digital capabilities to support precision marketing and production efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of baijiu products via a dealer-based distribution model, both offline and online. Additional revenue streams include hotel management services and sales of related products such as glass packaging. The company also earns income from investments and financial assets, but product sales constitute the vast majority of revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of China's top eight famous liquor brands and holds a strong market position in the premium baijiu segment. It competes with other leading Chinese liquor producers in a highly competitive and mature market. Strategic partnerships with other renowned liquor companies and continuous brand enhancement efforts help maintain its competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 23.58 billion, a 16.41% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 5.52 billion, up 20.22%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and cash flow, supported by strong brand recognition and expanding market presence. Total assets and equity have also increased, reflecting ongoing investments and operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its heritage as a historic royal tribute liquor with unique flavor profiles characterized by clarity, purity, and lasting aftertaste. It emphasizes high product quality, traditional craftsmanship combined with modern intelligent manufacturing, and cultural branding linked to Chinese heritage and festivals. The brand's strong reputation, multiple awards, and integration of digital marketing enhance customer loyalty and market influence.
